items.title: Ramstein Marks 25 Years Since 9/11 with 7th Annual Memorial March
items.description:
Before the first boots hit the pavement, every participant reached into a wooden crate and pulled out a lanyard.

items.title: The Intruder on the Edge of the Breach
items.description: On the morning of Sept. 11, 2001, at 9:37 a.m., American Airlines Flight 77 crashed into the Pentagon, claiming the lives of 184 people. Among them was Dana Wegner, the Navy's senior curator of models from Naval Surface Warfare Center, Carderock Division.

carriers.description: For most of his naval career, Lt. Kyle Fringer has experienced naval operations from the inside of a P-8A Poseidon multi-mission maritime patrol and reconnaissance aircraft. His background as a naval flight officer (NFO) taught him to understand the mission from the air, where he provided ships, other aircraft, and even troops on the ground with actionable information and intelligence.
